topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out someone went and tattooed one of my pieces on their arm. I didn't give permission. I didn't even know. Now this design, something I labored over, is permanently inked on a stranger’s skin. It's one thing to admire my work, but to take it and claim it like that? To alter it, to wear it as if it’s a common thing? I’m going to find out who did this, and I’m going to demand an explanation. This isn’t just about a纹身; it’s about respect for the creator. My creations aren’t free for the taking.
